title: intake_request
description: The redacted IntakeRequest produced on the device by Nemotron Nano. It is the only thing allowed to leave the device: no raw utterance, no symptoms, no identifiers.

care_type.description: What the appointment is for, e.g. dental cleaning.

budget_max.description: Cap in US dollars, or null when the request did not state one.

insurance_carrier.description: Carrier name only, e.g. Delta Dental. Never a member ID.

time_range.description: Date range the request may be scheduled in, resolved to the owner's timezone.

search_area.description: Where to search, e.g. near home or a city name. Never a street address.

dropped_fields.description: Names of the fields Nano removed, for the redaction metric. Field names from this fixed list only, never values.
